summary: Game files that server resources stream to this game. Files under a resource's stream/<folder>/kcds/<resource>/ folder, such as models, textures, sounds, animations and effects, are mounted where the game's loaders look, so they load by path like the game's own.

has.summary: Whether a mounted stream has this path. Only new files count, not replaced ones.
has.exampleLua:
-- The resource ships stream/objects/kcds/furniture/chair.cgf.
if kcds.core.Assets.has("objects/kcds/furniture/chair.cgf") then
  kcds.core.Events.toServer("furniture:ready")
end
